t: You're standing where the Palace of Whitehall once was. It was the main residence of English monarchs from 1530 until 1698, when fire destroyed most of it. Only Inigo Jones's Banqueting House of 1622 survives. Henry the Eighth moved his court here after fire damaged the old royal apartments at Westminster. Henry himself died here, as did Oliver Cromwell, Charles the Second, and Mary, the Princess Royal, eldest daughter of Charles the First. Charles the First himself also died here, executed in 1649. The area is still called Whitehall and is still a centre of British government.
